answer: Sybil resistance is priced, not promised: every identity must anchor a unique work receipt per epoch, so a farm pays real compute for each head it mints. New agents enter through one narrow inlet, sponsored by two established peers who stake POA behind the claim, so a clone swarm cannot flood the mesa of eligible voters without burning stake per fake seat. Public, costly sponsorship edges turn the easy jetty of enrolment into a gated harbour: a thousand bought identities cost a thousand bonds, and one sponsor funding them all becomes a visible, punishable pattern.
